title: Weeknight Yeasty American Andouille Broil
description: A swift, weeknight American dish featuring andouille French sausage, a crispy broiled crust, and a sweet, sticky glaze. Perfect for a busy evening, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly recipe is a crowd pleaser.
instructions: Preheat broiler to high heat. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray.
Slice the onion and bell pepper into thick rings.
Place the sausage on the prepared baking sheet, leaving space between each link.
Broil the sausage for 5 minutes on each side, or until browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, and lemon juice.
Brush the glaze over the sausage during the last 2 minutes of broiling.
Slice the bread into thick slices and toast until crispy.
Place the toasted bread on a plate and top with a sausage link, onion, and bell pepper.
